title: freeze RC21 local transactional lifecycle authority contract

criteria: Contract freezes gate order from RC20 local consumer readiness through operation intent catalog, journal/snapshot, fail-closed fixtures, dry-run plan, dry-run acceptance, explain/resume audit, repair/reinstall, downgrade/rollback, support/recovery, consumer smoke, and final audit.
Contract states repair, reinstall, downgrade, and rollback effects may run only inside disposable installed-system evidence until a later milestone explicitly authorizes host effects.

Contract forbids external mirror/frontend/nginx/signer/object-storage/private-key/support-upload/recovery-execution/remote-dispatch/host-rootfs/host-boot/production-ring authority and keeps production_ready_claim=false.
